map.输入系谱（每行一个个体：个体, 父, 母，父母未知则留空），自动计算每个个体的近: Enter a pedigree (one individual per line: individual, sire, dam; leave unknown parents blank); automatically compute each individual's inbreeding coefficient F and the additive genetic relationship matrix (A matrix).
map.系谱数据（每行：个体名, 父, 母）: Pedigree data (each line: name, sire, dam)
map.示例：S、A、D 为始祖；B=S×A、C=S×D；X=B×C（半同胞交配，预期: Example: S, A, D are founders; B=S×A, C=S×D; X=B×C (half-sib mating, expected F≈12.5%). Parents must appear before their offspring.
map.💡 Wright 公式：Fx = Σ (1/2)^(n₁+n₂+1) × (1+: Wright's formula: Fx = Σ (1/2)^(n1+n2+1) × (1+Fa); n1, n2 are the generations from sire and dam to the common ancestor, Fa is that ancestor's own inbreeding. Tabular method: Fi = ½ × A(sire_i, dam_i).
map.个体名区分大小写，不能重名；同一行用半角逗号分隔: Names are case-sensitive and must be unique; separate fields on a line with a half-width comma
map.父母须在后代之前出现，否则视为未知（始祖处理）: Parents must appear before offspring, otherwise treated as unknown (founder)
map.近交系数参考：F＜6.25% 可接受，6.25%~12.5% 需注意，＞12.5: Inbreeding reference: F<6.25% acceptable, 6.25%–12.5% caution, >12.5% high inbreeding-depression risk
map.由系谱（父/母）用矩阵法或路径法求个体近交系数 F。: From sire/dam, compute individual F via the tabular or path method.
map.育种规划避免近交衰退。: Breeding planning to avoid inbreeding depression.
map.输出亲缘矩阵与 F 评级。: Output the relationship matrix and F rating.
map.sire 同时是 dam 之父：后代 F=0.25（25%），属重度近交。: Sire is also the dam's father: offspring F=0.25 (25%), severe inbreeding.
map.共享一个祖代：F=0.125（12.5%），中度近交。: Share one grandparent: F=0.125 (12.5%), moderate inbreeding.
map.F 为个体基因纯合概率，F 越高近交衰退风险越大。: F is the probability of homozygosity; higher F means greater inbreeding-depression risk.
map.一般 F<6.25%（半叔侄级）可接受，≥12.5% 需警惕。: Generally F<6.25% (half-uncle-niece level) is acceptable; ≥12.5% needs caution.
map.用于家畜系谱分析。输入个体及其父母信息，采用 Henderson 表列法计算每个: For livestock pedigree analysis. Enter individuals and their parents; compute each individual's inbreeding coefficient by Henderson's tabular method (equivalent to Wright's path formula) and output the full additive relationship matrix (A matrix) for mating and kinship analysis.
map.自动拓扑排序与循环检测: Automatic topological sort and cycle detection
